app_ping.title: Test command (ping)
app_ping.description: Returns the version, platform and state of XcreenShot. Used to check that the UI, shortcuts and the CLI reach the app.

app_commands.title: List commands
app_commands.description: Lists every registered command with its parameter and result schemas.

app_close_window.title: Close window
app_close_window.description: Closes the active XcreenShot window. The app keeps running in the background.

app_quit.title: Quit XcreenShot
app_quit.description: Quits the app, releases global shortcuts and removes the icon. With documents that have unsaved changes outside the library it asks first and returns status needs_decision, unless --force.

app_diagnostics.title: Diagnostic information
app_diagnostics.description: Collects version, system, monitors, permissions, shortcut conflicts and the last log lines. With copy, puts the text on the clipboard.

events_watch.title: Watch events
events_watch.description: Writes one JSON line per event (captures started, finished, cancelled or failed; files written; app state) until interrupted.

app_welcome.title: Show the welcome again
app_welcome.description: Shows the welcome window of the first run: language, shortcuts, startup and library.

app_help.title: XcreenShot Help
app_help.description: Opens the help pages, which work without a connection, at a topic.

app_about.title: About XcreenShot
app_about.description: Version, build, architecture, channel, where the data is, and the only network connections the app makes.

app_feedback.title: Send feedback
app_feedback.description: Opens a draft in the browser (a new issue of the project) with the version and the system filled in. XcreenShot sends nothing by itself.

app_open_logs.title: Open logs folder
app_open_logs.description: Opens the folder with the local log files.

app_open_data_folder.title: Open the app data folder
app_open_data_folder.description: Opens the folder where XcreenShot keeps its local data (logs, recovery copies, the library index). Returns it and the settings folder.

app_permissions.title: Permission status
app_permissions.description: Lists the system permissions XcreenShot uses and whether they are granted.

app_request_permission.title: Request permission
app_request_permission.description: Shows the system request for a permission, if the system still allows asking.

app_open_permission_settings.title: Open permission settings
app_open_permission_settings.description: Opens the exact System Settings page for a permission (macOS).

settings_open.title: Preferences
settings_open.description: Opens the Preferences window, optionally at a section or setting.

settings_get.title: Get setting
settings_get.description: Returns the current value of a setting key.

settings_set.title: Change setting
settings_set.description: Changes a setting. Automation settings can only be changed in Preferences.

settings_reset.title: Reset settings
settings_reset.description: Puts the settings of a section, or every setting and shortcut, back to their defaults. Captures, the library and saved styles are never touched.

app_hints.title: Hints
app_hints.description: Which one-time hints were seen; marks one as seen.

app_warnings.title: Warnings and hints
app_warnings.description: Counts the warnings answered with "Don't ask again" and the hints already seen; with reset, shows them all again.

settings_list.title: List settings
settings_list.description: Lists every setting key with its type, default value, current value and lock state.

settings_schema.title: Settings schema
settings_schema.description: Returns the definition of every setting key.

shortcuts_list.title: List shortcuts
shortcuts_list.description: Lists every assignable shortcut with its current combination and status.

shortcuts_set.title: Set shortcut
shortcuts_set.description: Assigns a key combination to a command, or removes it with an empty value.

shortcuts_reset.title: Restore shortcuts
shortcuts_reset.description: Restores one shortcut, or all of them, to the active profile's default.

shortcuts_pause.title: Pause global shortcuts
shortcuts_pause.description: Pauses or resumes every global shortcut of XcreenShot.

shortcuts_set_profile.title: Change shortcut profile
shortcuts_set_profile.description: Switches between the Coexistence and Compatibility profiles. Custom shortcuts are kept unless resetCustom is set.

shortcuts_retry.title: Retry shortcuts
shortcuts_retry.description: Tries again to activate the global shortcuts that could not be registered.

shortcuts_open_system_settings.title: Open system keyboard settings
shortcuts_open_system_settings.description: Opens the system page where its own keyboard shortcuts are changed.

shortcuts_recording.title: Recording a shortcut
shortcuts_recording.description: Suspends global shortcuts while the user records a new combination.

capture_monitors.title: List monitors
capture_monitors.description: Lists the monitors with their position, size in physical pixels, scale and name.

capture_fullscreen.title: Full screen capture
capture_fullscreen.description: Captures a monitor (under the pointer by default), the primary one, all of them, or one by name.

capture_region.title: Region capture
capture_region.description: Captures a rectangle of the desktop in physical pixels. Without a rectangle, shows the on-screen selection.

capture_window.title: Window capture
capture_window.description: Captures a whole window, even if another window covers it: the active one, the one at a point, or the first whose title or process matches.

capture_universal.title: Universal Capture
capture_universal.description: Captures with the Universal tab settings: freezes the screen and shows the crosshair; drag a region, click a window or press F, then choose Capture.

capture_capture.title: Capture
capture_capture.description: Starts a capture with the settings of the active tab of the capture panel, even if the panel is closed.

capture_image.title: Image Capture
capture_image.description: Starts a capture with the Image tab settings, whatever tab is active.

capture_repeat_last.title: Repeat Last Capture
capture_repeat_last.description: Runs the last capture again with the same mode and settings. With no previous capture, opens the capture panel.

capture_panel.title: Show or Hide Capture Panel
capture_panel.description: Shows or hides the capture panel. Without show, it hides when it is in front and comes to the front otherwise.

capture_settings.title: Capture panel settings
capture_settings.description: Returns the active tab and the Universal and Image tab settings.

capture_configure.title: Change capture panel settings
capture_configure.description: Changes some capture panel settings; the rest stay as they are.

capture_reset_settings.title: Reset capture settings
capture_reset_settings.description: Returns the Universal and Image tabs to their defaults. Presets, shortcuts and preferences do not change.

capture_repeat_last_area.title: Repeat Last Area
capture_repeat_last_area.description: Captures at once, without the crosshair, the same screen rectangle as the last region or window capture; a window that is still open is captured where it is now. With no previous capture, opens the capture panel.

document_open.title: Open document
document_open.description: Opens a .xshot, PNG or JPG file as a document. Returns its documentId for the other document commands.

document_list.title: Open documents
document_list.description: The documents open in the editor, in order, with which one is shown and which have unsaved changes.

document_info.title: Document details
document_info.description: Size, resolution, objects (id, type, geometry, style), capture metadata and unsaved state of a document.

document_annotate.title: Annotate
document_annotate.description: Adds objects (arrows for now) to a document in image pixels. All are created or none, as one undo step.

document_update_object.title: Change object
document_update_object.description: Changes the geometry or style of one or more objects, as one undo step.

document_arrange.title: Arrange objects
document_arrange.description: Brings objects to the front or one place forward, or sends them one place backward or to the back.

document_steps.title: Step sequence
document_steps.description: Restarts the sequence of step markers or numbers them again without gaps.

document_flatten.title: Flatten objects
document_flatten.description: Merges objects into the image; they can be made objects again, except a blur.

document_unflatten.title: Unflatten
document_unflatten.description: Makes flattened objects editable objects again.

document_transform.title: Transform objects
document_transform.description: Stretches, turns or gives the same size to several objects as one.

document_group.title: Group objects
document_group.description: Puts objects in a group that is selected and moved as one, or takes them out of it.

document_duplicate.title: Duplicate objects
document_duplicate.description: Copies objects, moved a little from the originals, on top of the others.

document_delete_object.title: Delete object
document_delete_object.description: Deletes one or more objects, as one undo step.

document_undo.title: Undo
document_undo.description: Undoes the last change of a document.

document_redo.title: Redo
document_redo.description: Redoes the last undone change of a document.

document_save.title: Save
document_save.description: Saves a document in its own file. With a path it saves as: a copy for library documents, or the new linked file for files opened from elsewhere.

document_export.title: Export
document_export.description: Writes the final image (pixels and objects, flattened) as PNG or JPG without changing the document's own file.

document_copy_all.title: Copy all
document_copy_all.description: Copies the final image of a document to the clipboard. The document keeps its objects editable.

document_close.title: Close document
document_close.description: Closes a document (or all). Library documents are saved first; files from elsewhere with unsaved changes need save or discard, otherwise nothing closes and status is needs_decision.

editor_show.title: Show the editor
editor_show.description: Shows the main window in the Editor view, optionally with a given document.

editor_state.title: Editor state
editor_state.description: Active tool, the current style of each tool and the document shown.

editor_select_tool.title: Select tool
editor_select_tool.description: Makes a tool the active one in the editor.

editor_set_style.title: Set tool style
editor_set_style.description: Changes the current style of a tool: the properties of the next objects it draws. Kept between sessions.

editor_zoom.title: Zoom
editor_zoom.description: Changes the editor zoom: actual size, fit to window, original on-screen size, in, out or a percentage (10-3200).

editor_view.title: Editor view
editor_view.description: The editor reports the zoom and position of the document it shows.

editor_recovery_list.title: Recoverable work
editor_recovery_list.description: Documents with unsaved changes kept from a session that ended unexpectedly.

editor_recovery_restore.title: Recover work
editor_recovery_restore.description: Opens recoverable documents with their changes.

document_crop.title: Crop
document_crop.description: Crops the document to a rectangle in canvas pixels. Nothing is lost: the original pixels stay in the .xshot and a later crop can grow back to the original edges. Objects keep their place on the image. One undo step.

editor_fonts.title: Installed fonts
editor_fonts.description: Font families installed on this computer, for text objects.

document_copy_objects.title: Copy objects
document_copy_objects.description: Copies objects so they paste editable in XcreenShot, and as a PNG with transparency for other apps. With cut, also deletes them.

document_paste.title: Paste
document_paste.description: Pastes the clipboard: objects copied in XcreenShot (editable, shifted 10 px if the originals are still there, or in place), plain text as a text object, or an image as a floating image of the document shown, or as a new document if nothing is open.

editor_action.title: Editor action
editor_action.description: Does what an editor menu entry does, in the editor window: open, save, export, close, undo, cut, copy, paste, delete, show the side panel… For automation, the document.* commands work without the window.

editor_menu_state.title: Editor menu state
editor_menu_state.description: The editor window reports which of its menu entries can be used now and which are ticked.

capture_multi_start.title: Multi-capture
capture_multi_start.description: Starts multi-capture: every click captures the window under the pointer as it looked just before the click, and then reaches the app; a drag captures a rectangle. Esc ends it. The captures of the session are listed in a panel.

capture_multi_stop.title: Finish multi-capture
capture_multi_stop.description: Stops capturing clicks. The panel stays so its captures can still be inserted, unless close also closes it and forgets the session.

capture_multi_state.title: Multi-capture state
capture_multi_state.description: Whether clicks are being captured and the captures of the session.

capture_multi_remove.title: Remove from multi-capture
capture_multi_remove.description: Takes captures out of the multi-capture panel. They stay in the library.

capture_multi_clear.title: Clear multi-capture
capture_multi_clear.description: Empties the multi-capture panel. The captures stay in the library.

document_insert_images.title: Insert images
document_insert_images.description: Inserts library documents or image files as floating images of the document shown, in a cascade from the center. With nothing open, one library document opens as itself and several make a new document with them stacked.

ai_key_set.title: Save the AI key
ai_key_set.description: Saves the Claude API key in the system keychain. Only from Preferences > AI.

ai_key_clear.title: Remove the AI key
ai_key_clear.description: Removes the Claude API key from the system keychain.

ai_key_status.title: AI key status
ai_key_status.description: Whether a Claude API key is saved, and its last four characters.

ai_key_test.title: Test the AI key
ai_key_test.description: Checks the saved key and the model with the Claude API, without sending any image.

ai_ask.title: Ask the AI
ai_ask.description: Sends the final image of a document and a request to Claude, and returns the answer. Needs cloud AI turned on in Preferences > AI.

ai_suggest_name.title: Suggest a name with AI
ai_suggest_name.description: Asks Claude for a short descriptive file name for the image of a document. Does not rename it.

ai_cancel.title: Stop the AI
ai_cancel.description: Stops the AI request in progress.

document_rename.title: Rename document
document_rename.description: Renames the file of an open document in its folder, keeping its extension. Never replaces another file.

document_image.title: Document image
document_image.description: The final image of a document as a PNG (base64), scaled down to maxSize on its longest side, for an agent to look at.

ai_open_console.title: Get an AI key
ai_open_console.description: Opens the page where Claude API keys are created, in the browser.

app_mcp_config.title: MCP client configuration
app_mcp_config.description: How an MCP client (Claude Desktop, Claude Code…) starts XcreenShot: the installed CLI and its arguments.

library_list.title: Library items
library_list.description: Items of the library, newest capture first, with their stable ID.

library_get.title: Library item
library_get.description: One library item: name, file, format, size and capture data.

library_delete.title: Delete from the library
library_delete.description: Moves items to the system's trash (or deletes them for good), with Undo for a while.

library_restore.title: Undo delete
library_restore.description: Brings back items just deleted from the library.

library_rename.title: Rename library item
library_rename.description: Renames an item's file in its folder, keeping its ID.

library_show_in_folder.title: Show in folder
library_show_in_folder.description: Opens the folder of an item, or of the library, with the file selected.

document_locate.title: Locate document file
document_locate.description: Links an open document to its file after it was moved outside XcreenShot.

editor_stamps.title: Stamp collection
editor_stamps.description: Lists the stamps you can place, by category or by words.

document_simplify_view.title: Simplify view
document_simplify_view.description: Shows or hides the original image under simplified shapes.

document_fill.title: Fill
document_fill.description: Fills the clicked pixel and the touching pixels of a similar color with a color or with transparency, on the image or on a floating image.

document_erase.title: Erase
document_erase.description: Erases the image, or a floating image, along a stroke: the canvas color shows through.

document_select_pixels.title: Select pixels
document_select_pixels.description: Selects pixels of the image or of a floating image with a rectangle, ellipse, polygon, freehand loop or the magic wand; adds, subtracts, inverts or drops the selection.

document_selection_action.title: Act on selected pixels
document_selection_action.description: Deletes, cuts, copies, moves, floats or crops to the selected pixels, filling the gap they leave.

editor_cancel.title: Cancel
editor_cancel.description: Stops a long editor task that is running: the Photo smart fill. Nothing changes.

editor_styles.title: Saved styles
editor_styles.description: Lists the saved styles of the active theme for each tool, and the favorites.

editor_style.title: Saved style
editor_style.description: Applies, saves, updates, renames, deletes, moves or resets saved styles, and adds, removes, moves or uses favorites.

editor_themes.title: Themes
editor_themes.description: Lists the themes and which one is active.

editor_theme.title: Theme
editor_theme.description: Activates, creates or changes, duplicates, renames, deletes, exports or imports a theme (.xtheme).

editor_colors.title: Colors
editor_colors.description: Lists My colors and the recent colors of the color selector, shared by every window.

editor_color.title: Color
editor_color.description: Adds a color to My colors (up to 24), removes it, or marks it as used (the last 8 are Recent).

document_effects.title: Effects
document_effects.description: Sets, adds, changes, removes, reorders or turns off the effects of the document or of a floating image. They are not destructive: the file keeps the image without them.

editor_saved_effects.title: Saved effects
editor_saved_effects.description: Lists the saved effects: ready combinations of effects, with their names.

editor_saved_effect.title: Saved effect
editor_saved_effect.description: Applies a saved effect (or adds it at the end), saves the current stack as one, renames, updates, deletes, moves it, or adds it to Favorites.

document_resize.title: Resize image
document_resize.description: Changes the size of the image, resampling its pixels (or only its resolution); objects scale with it, text sizes too.

document_rotate.title: Rotate image
document_rotate.description: Turns the image and its objects 90°, 180°, 270° or any angle; the canvas grows to hold it.

document_revert.title: Revert to original
document_revert.description: Drops every edit (objects, effects, crops, size and canvas) and leaves the image as captured or opened. Undo brings them back.

document_canvas.title: Canvas
document_canvas.description: Sets the canvas color (or transparent), its rounded corners (or a circle) and the resolution.

document_canvas_size.title: Canvas size
document_canvas_size.description: Sets the canvas size around an anchor: growing adds space, shrinking hides what falls out (it can come back).

document_flip.title: Flip
document_flip.description: Flips the image and its objects (or only some objects) horizontally or vertically; text stays readable and floating images flip too.

document_trim.title: Trim edges
document_trim.description: Removes uniform or transparent borders around the image (the color of the top-left pixel, within a tolerance). Says so when there are none.

document_fit_canvas.title: Fit canvas to content
document_fit_canvas.description: Makes the canvas the rectangle that holds the original image and every object, so nothing is left outside.

document_crop_to_canvas.title: Crop to canvas
document_crop_to_canvas.description: Removes what sticks out of the canvas: floating images lose that part of their picture; annotations stay and are reported.

document_cut_out.title: Cut out or add space
document_cut_out.description: Removes a strip of the whole width (or height) and joins the parts, straight or with a torn, wavy or zigzag gap; or adds that much space. Objects after the strip move with it; those across it stay and are reported.

document_new.title: New image
document_new.description: Creates a blank document of the size, canvas color and resolution given (or the remembered ones) in the library.

document_new_from_clipboard.title: New from clipboard
document_new_from_clipboard.description: Creates a document from the clipboard's image, image file or text (a canvas that fits it, with a text object).

editor_clipboard.title: What the clipboard has
editor_clipboard.description: Says whether the clipboard has an image (and its size), image files or text.

document_batch_export.title: Batch export
document_batch_export.description: Exports many files at once to one format, with a saved effect or a stack added, into a folder or next to each original, keeping the names or numbering them. The sources do not change; editor.cancel stops it.

document_print_pages.title: Pages to print
document_print_pages.description: The final image (or a part of the canvas) laid out on paper: each page's picture and where it goes, in millimeters.

document_print.title: Print
document_print.description: Lays the final image out on paper as a PDF (paper, orientation, margins, size, pages between lines of text) and opens it in the system's viewer to print with its dialog.

editor_toolbar.title: Toolbar
editor_toolbar.description: Reads or changes what the editor toolbar shows, in order: tools, commands, effects, separators and flexible spaces; reset goes back to the default.

editor_templates.title: Templates
editor_templates.description: Lists the built-in and own templates of the picker; renames, duplicates, deletes, imports or exports an own template.

document_from_template.title: New from template
document_from_template.description: Creates a document from a template with up to 20 images in its zones, in order.

document_template.title: Template
document_template.description: Reads or changes a template: its settings, its sections and its image zones (fill, clear, swap, frame).

document_save_as_template.title: Save as template
document_save_as_template.description: Saves the document as an own template (.xtemplate) in the templates folder.

document_apply_theme.title: Apply theme
document_apply_theme.description: Gives the selected objects, or all, the colors and font of a theme, in one undo step.

library_tag.title: Tag items
library_tag.description: Adds and removes tags on library items; their files and dates do not change.

library_tags.title: Library tags
library_tags.description: Lists the tags with their counts, and renames, merges or deletes a tag on all its items.

library_favorite.title: Favorites
library_favorite.description: Marks or unmarks library items as favorites.

library_rebuild.title: Rebuild the library index
library_rebuild.description: Builds the library index again from the files; IDs, tags and favorites come back from each item's sidecar.

library_check.title: Check the library
library_check.description: Lists files that cannot be read and metadata files without their item, and whether the folder can be written; can clean up those metadata files.

library_location.title: Library location
library_location.description: Where the library is, and what a folder holds before choosing it.

library_relocate.title: Change the library location
library_relocate.description: Moves the library to another folder, starts an empty one there or uses the one already there.

library_search.title: Search the library
library_search.description: Finds library items by text, tags, type, application, website, capture days and favorites.

library_reveal.title: Show in library
library_reveal.description: Shows the Library view with the item selected and in view, clearing the filters that hide it.

library_resolve.title: Resolve a sync conflict
library_resolve.description: Keeps the conflict copy, the original or both, when a sync service made a copy of an item changed on two computers.

library_open_url.title: Open the website
library_open_url.description: Opens the website a library item was captured from in the default browser.

library_export.title: Export the library
library_export.description: Copies the whole library, or what the filters show, to a folder as plain files: images with their annotations as PNG or JPG, the subfolders kept, and a CSV with each item's details.

library_import.title: Import to the library
library_import.description: Copies files and folders into the library, each in the folder of the month of its date; a folder's name can become a tag.

tray_list.title: List the recent tray
tray_list.description: The items of the recent tray, left to right, with their library ID and whether each is pinned, unsaved or shown.

tray_open.title: Open in the tray
tray_open.description: Opens a library item or a file and puts it in the recent tray.

tray_activate.title: Show a tray item
tray_activate.description: Shows an item of the recent tray in the editor.

tray_pin.title: Pin in the tray
tray_pin.description: Pins items at the left of the recent tray: they never leave it by themselves.

tray_unpin.title: Unpin from the tray
tray_unpin.description: Unpins items of the recent tray; they go back to their place by arrival.

tray_move.title: Move in the tray
tray_move.description: Moves an item of the recent tray to another place.

tray_close.title: Close tray items
tray_close.description: Closes items of the recent tray (one, the others, all or the unpinned ones) without deleting their files.

library_duplicate.title: Duplicate items
library_duplicate.description: Makes a full, independent copy of each item beside it, with its editable objects, tags and capture details.

settings_export.title: Export settings
settings_export.description: Writes the preferences, shortcuts, themes and saved effects, and the toolbar to an .xsettings file. It never holds passwords, tokens, the library or the logs.

settings_import.title: Import settings
settings_import.description: Applies an .xsettings file, by group; shortcuts from the other platform can be converted.

shortcuts_export.title: Export the shortcut sheet
shortcuts_export.description: Writes every current shortcut, grouped, as a PDF of one or two A4 pages, a printable HTML page or JSON.

general_launchAtLogin.label: Start XcreenShot when you sign in
general_launchAtLogin.description: Starts in the background, with only the icon and shortcuts.

general_showIcon.label: Show the icon
general_showIcon.description: Shows the XcreenShot icon in the notification area or the menu bar.

general_monochromeIcon.label: Monochrome icon
general_monochromeIcon.description: Draws the icon in a single color that adapts to a light or dark bar.

general_iconClickAction.label: Clicking the icon
general_iconClickAction.description: What a left click on the icon does.

general_keepRunning.label: Keep running in the background when all windows are closed
general_keepRunning.description: If off, closing the last window quits XcreenShot.

general_tooltips.label: Tooltips
general_tooltips.description: How much the tooltips say when you rest the pointer on a button.

general_hints.label: Show hints
general_hints.description: Short tips that appear once, the first time you use something.

notifications_captures.label: Notify about captures
notifications_captures.description: When a capture goes to the clipboard or the library without opening a window. Clicking the notification opens it in the editor.

notifications_problems.label: Notify about problems
notifications_problems.description: Shortcuts that could not be turned on, black captures, files that could not be saved.

notifications_automation.label: Notify about automation
notifications_automation.description: When the command line or an agent (MCP) takes a capture.

capture_sound.label: Sound when capturing
capture_sound.description: Plays once when the capture is taken, at the system volume. Silent while Do not disturb is on.

capture_flash.label: Flash the captured area
capture_flash.description: The area lights up for an instant. It never appears in a capture.

general_language.label: Language
general_language.description: Language of the interface. System uses Spanish for any Spanish system language.

shortcuts_takeOver.label: Take shortcuts used by other apps while XcreenShot is open
shortcuts_takeOver.description: Only where the system allows it. Other apps get them back when XcreenShot quits.

advanced_keepEditorLoaded.label: Keep the editor loaded in the background
advanced_keepEditorLoaded.description: The next capture opens faster. Turn off to use less memory.

automation_enabled.label: Allow control from the CLI and agents (MCP)
automation_enabled.description: If off, commands from the terminal or agents are refused.

automation_notifyOnCapture.label: Notify when automation captures or records
automation_notifyOnCapture.description: Shows a notification for every capture or recording started by the CLI or an agent.

automation_allowOnlineShare.label: Allow automation to send to online destinations

diagnostics_verbose.label: Detailed logging
diagnostics_verbose.description: Adds debugging information to the logs. Turns itself off after 24 hours.

capture_hideOnCapture.label: Hide XcreenShot when capturing
capture_hideOnCapture.description: Hides the capture panel, the editor and notifications before taking the image.

capture_metadata_windowTitle.label: Save the window title
capture_metadata_windowTitle.description: Stores the title of the captured window in the capture details.

capture_metadata_url.label: Save the web address
capture_metadata_url.description: Stores the address of the page when the capture comes from a browser.

capture_metadata_userAndMachine.label: Save the user and computer name
capture_metadata_userAndMachine.description: Stores your account name and the computer name in the capture details.

capture_showMagnifier.label: Show the magnifier at the start
capture_showMagnifier.description: A zoomed view of the pixels around the pointer. M shows or hides it during a capture.

capture_autoDetect.label: Automatic detection
capture_autoDetect.description: Highlights the window under the pointer so one click selects it. Dragging always works.

capture_simpleCrosshair.label: Simplified crosshair
capture_simpleCrosshair.description: Thin lines only, without darkening the screen or the coordinates label. For slow computers, virtual machines, remote desktops and many high-resolution monitors.

editor_deleteCroppedContent.label: Delete cropped content when saving
editor_deleteCroppedContent.description: Saved documents keep only the cropped image, so a shared .xshot holds nothing hidden. Without it, a later crop can recover what was cut.

editor_scaleStrokes.label: Scale line widths and text
editor_scaleStrokes.description: When several objects are resized together, their line widths and text sizes grow and shrink with them.

editor_autoExpandCanvas.label: Expand the canvas automatically
editor_autoExpandCanvas.description: When an object sticks out of the image, the canvas grows just enough to show it, and shrinks back when it returns. What a crop leaves outside stays outside.

editor_shrinkToFit.label: Shrink to fit when opening
editor_shrinkToFit.description: An image larger than the window opens fitted to it; a smaller one opens at 100 %.

editor_rememberView.label: Remember each document's zoom and position
editor_rememberView.description: Opening a document again shows it as you left it.

editor_reopenDocuments.label: Reopen the documents that were open
editor_reopenDocuments.description: When XcreenShot starts, the editor has the documents you had open, in the same order.

editor_escClosesEditor.label: Esc closes the editor
editor_escClosesEditor.description: With nothing to cancel (no drawing, selection or text being typed), Esc closes the editor window. The documents stay open.

editor_toolbarLabels.label: Toolbar labels
editor_toolbarLabels.description: Shows each tool's name next to its icon when the window is wide enough. Also in View > Toolbar and with a right click on the toolbar.

editor_autoSelectAfterDraw.label: Select an annotation after drawing it
editor_autoSelectAfterDraw.description: The object you just drew stays selected, ready to change.

ai_enabled.label: Use cloud AI (Claude, by Anthropic)
ai_enabled.description: Lets you ask Claude about an image and get file name suggestions. An image is sent only when you ask, with your own key.

ai_namingModel.label: Model for names
ai_namingModel.description: Used by Suggest name. A cheaper model is enough.

library_autosaveImages.label: Save image captures to the library automatically
library_autosaveImages.description: Off: new captures stay unsaved until you save them, and XcreenShot asks before losing them.

library_keepEditableCopy.label: Keep an editable copy when saving to another format
library_keepEditableCopy.description: Saving annotations into a PNG or JPG from elsewhere also keeps an editable .xshot in the library.

library_confirmDelete.label: Confirm before deleting
library_confirmDelete.description: Ask before moving library items to the trash.

tray_clearUnpinnedOnExit.label: Clear unpinned items from the recent tray when quitting
tray_clearUnpinnedOnExit.description: On quitting XcreenShot, the recent tray keeps only its pinned items. The files stay in the library.

editor_simplifyLockOnExit.label: Lock simplified shapes on exit
editor_simplifyLockOnExit.description: When you leave the Simplify tool, its shapes are locked so they do not move by accident.

editor_cursorStylePreview.label: Style preview by the pointer
editor_cursorStylePreview.description: With a drawing tool, a small sample of its current style follows the pointer over the canvas.

editor_snap.label: Snap objects into place
editor_snap.description: When you move or resize an object, its edges and center line up with the canvas and other objects, and with equal spaces between them. Hold Ctrl (Cmd) to move freely.

editor_newImage_width.label: Width of a new image
editor_newImage_width.description: In pixels; File > New image starts with it.

editor_newImage_color.label: Canvas color of a new image

editor_flattenBackground.label: Background for formats without transparency
editor_flattenBackground.description: A color like #FFFFFF: what transparent areas become in JPG, BMP and PDF.

editor_pixelGrid.label: Pixel grid
editor_pixelGrid.description: From a zoom on, a fine grid separates the pixels of the image. It is never part of the image.

editor_workspaceColor.label: Workspace color
editor_workspaceColor.description: "auto" follows the light or dark theme; or a color like #2B2B33.

editor_quickEditBar.label: Quick edit bar
editor_quickEditBar.description: A small bar next to the selected object with its most used properties and saved styles.

tray_capacity.label: Items in the recent tray
tray_capacity.description: From 1 to 200. Over this, the oldest items that are not pinned and have no unsaved changes leave the tray; they stay in the library.

tray_thumbnailSize.label: Tray thumbnail size
tray_thumbnailSize.description: The height of the recent tray’s thumbnails.

welcome.title: Welcome to XcreenShot
welcome.language_body: XcreenShot speaks English and Spanish. It starts in the language of your system.
welcome.shortcuts_question: Do you use another capture app on this computer?
welcome.shortcuts_yes_body: XcreenShot keeps keys that do not clash with it.
welcome.shortcuts_no_body: You can use the keys people know from other capture tools, starting with PrtScn.
welcome.shortcuts_compat_on: Done: the compatibility keys are on.
welcome.shortcuts_failed: not active: another app uses it
welcome.startup_login: Start XcreenShot when I sign in
welcome.startup_login_help: It waits next to the clock, so the capture shortcut always works.
welcome.library_change_later: You can see it and open it later in Preferences > Library.
welcome.done_body: Press {{keys}} whenever you want to capture. Everything you set here can be changed in Preferences.

help.title: XcreenShot Help
help.privacy: XcreenShot collects no usage data and sends no telemetry. It only connects to the internet to share what you choose to share, to check for updates and, if you turn it on, to ask the cloud AI about an image you choose.
help.feedback_help: Opens a draft in your browser. You review it and decide whether to send it.
help.licenses_help: XcreenShot is built on {{count}} open-source components. Each keeps its own license:

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.data_folder_help: Logs, recovery copies and the library index. Your settings are in {{config}}.
prefs.cli_help: Scripts and agents run XcreenShot with this command (see AGENTS.md).
prefs.cli_missing: Not installed with this copy of XcreenShot. The installer adds it.
prefs.experimental_intro: Features that are not final yet. They may change or go away in an update. XcreenShot collects no data when you turn them on.
prefs.experimental_none: No features on trial in this version.
prefs.reset_section_body: The settings of {{name}} go back to their defaults. Your captures, the library and your saved styles do not change.
prefs.reset_all_body: Every setting of every section, the shortcut profile and every shortcut go back to their defaults. Your captures, the library, saved styles and the accounts of your destinations do not change.
prefs.warnings_none: No warning or hint is hidden.
prefs.empty_section: Nothing to set here yet. These settings arrive with their features.

transfer.title: Settings file
transfer.help: Take your preferences, shortcuts, themes and toolbar to another computer. Passwords, the library and the logs never go in the file.
transfer.export_help: Choose what goes in the .xsettings file.
transfer.import_help: This is what each group changes on this computer. Untick what you want to keep as it is.
transfer.convert: Convert the shortcuts made on {{platform}} (Ctrl ↔ Cmd, Alt ↔ Option, Win ↔ Control)
transfer.conflict: A theme or effect with the same name
transfer.unassigned_one: {{count}} shortcut had no equivalent here and was left unassigned.
transfer.unassigned_other: {{count}} shortcuts had no equivalent here and were left unassigned.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.none_needed: XcreenShot needs no special permissions on this system.
permissions.help: Turn XcreenShot on in the list. If it already looks on but capture does not work, remove it from the list and add it again.

purpose.screen_recording: Every screen or window capture and every recording, including system audio.
purpose.accessibility: Auto-scroll, menu capture, the Step Recorder and showing keystrokes in video.
purpose.camera: The camera in recordings and camera captures.
purpose.microphone: Microphone audio in recordings and narrated slides.
purpose.notifications: Notices of captures copied or saved without opening a window, and of problems.

shortcuts.profile_help_compatibility: Same default shortcuts as the most common capture app on each platform.

keys.color: copy the color under the pointer

overlay.hint: Drag to select · Click a window · F full screen · M magnifier · Esc cancel

panel.title: XcreenShot · Capture
panel.cursor_help: The pointer arrives as its own object: you can move it or delete it.
panel.reset_body: The Universal and Image tabs go back to their default values. Presets, shortcuts and preferences do not change.

editor.align_help: Against the selection; one object, against the canvas.
editor.flatten_blur_body: A flattened blur cannot be unflattened: when the file is saved, it no longer has what the blur hides. Anything flattened earlier under it stays flat too. You can still undo it now with Undo.
editor.unflatten_blur: A flattened blur cannot be unflattened: its purpose is to hide what is below it.
editor.unflatten_covered: A blur was flattened over it, so it is now part of the image.

tool_detail.move: Select objects to move them, resize them or change them in Properties.
tool_detail.arrow: Drag on the capture to point at something.
tool_detail.text: Click to write; drag to make a text box.
tool_detail.shape: Drag to draw a rectangle or an ellipse.
tool_detail.blur: Drag over what should not be seen: blur, pixelate or solid.
tool_detail.crop: Drag to keep a part. Nothing is lost: crop again to bring it back.
tool_detail.step: Click to place the next number; drag for a bigger marker.
tool_detail.callout: Drag to draw a box with a tail, then type. Drag a tail’s tip to point.
tool_detail.line: Drag to draw a line; Shift keeps it straight or at 45°.
tool_detail.highlight: Drag over what to mark; dark text stays readable.
tool_detail.pen: Draw freehand; Shift draws a straight line.
tool_detail.magnify: Drag over a zone to show it enlarged; drag the lens elsewhere.
tool_detail.spotlight: Drag around what matters: the rest darkens or blurs.
tool_detail.stamp: Pick a stamp in Styles, then click to place it; drag for another size.
tool_detail.simplify: Drag to cover text and details with flat shapes.
tool_detail.fill: Click to fill an area of similar color, or make it transparent.
tool_detail.eraser: Drag to erase the image; the canvas color shows. Objects stay.
tool_detail.select: Drag to select pixels; drag inside to move them. Shift adds, Alt subtracts.
tool_detail.wand: Click to select an area of similar color. Shift adds, Alt subtracts.
tool_detail.favorites: Your starred styles of every tool: click one to draw with it.
tool_detail.cutout: Drag across the image to remove a strip of the whole width (Shift: of the whole height), or to add space.

editor.canvas_label: Canvas of {{name}}. Drag to draw with the active tool.

editor.unsaved_close: If you don't save, your changes will be lost.
editor.unsaved_quit: XcreenShot is about to quit. If you don't save, your changes will be lost.
editor.flatten_body: “{{name}}” is a PNG or JPG file. When saved, its annotations become part of the image and can no longer be edited in that file. To keep them editable, use Save as… and choose XcreenShot document.
editor.recover_body: XcreenShot closed unexpectedly. These documents had unsaved changes:
editor.nothing_to_recover: There is no work to recover.
editor.empty_help: Take a capture, open an image or a .xshot document, or drop files here.
editor.crop_help: Drag the edges or corners, or drag a new box. Enter or double-click applies; Esc puts it back. What is cut stays in the document and can be recovered by cropping again.

blur.solid_hint: Best for confidential data: blur and pixelation can sometimes be reversed with outside tools.
blur.security: Exported images and copies never keep what a blur hides. A .xshot does, until the blur is flattened.

editor.not_found_help: The file was moved or deleted outside XcreenShot.
editor.not_in_library: This file is not in the library
editor.unflatten_painted: It was painted into the image, so it cannot be unflattened.
editor.unflatten_edited: It was filled or erased over, so it is now part of the image.

pixel.floating_only: This works on the image, not on a floating image.
pixel.quality_help: Fast suits interfaces and flat backgrounds; Photo, photos and textures (slower).

image.resolution_hint: The pixels do not change: only the size when the image is printed or inserted in a document.

template.add_section_after: Add a section after this one

multi.remove_hint: Remove from the panel (it stays in the library)

ai.intro: Ask Claude about an image (a description, alt text, a summary, a poem…) and get file name suggestions. XcreenShot sends an image only when you ask, with your own key. Each request uses credit from your API account.
ai.key_hint: Saved in the system keychain, never in a file.
ai.consent_what: What is sent: the final image of the document and the text you write, only when you press Send or Suggest name.
ai.consent_who: To whom: Anthropic, over an encrypted connection to api.anthropic.com, with your own API key.
ai.consent_cost: Cost: each request uses credit from your API account.
ai.consent_rest: Everything else in XcreenShot keeps working offline, as before.
ai.sending: The image of this document ({{width}} × {{height}} px) and your text will be sent to Anthropic ({{model}}).
ai.prompt_alt: Write alt text for this image, for a screen reader: one or two sentences.
ai.prompt_summary: Summarize the text in this image in a few bullet points.
ai.prompt_poem: Write a short poem inspired by this image.
ai.prompt_label: What should the AI do with this image?
ai.prompt_placeholder: For example: a poem for Ana and Luis, who are celebrating 10 years of marriage
ai.mcp_title: Use XcreenShot from Claude Desktop or Claude Code
ai.mcp_body: Another way, without a key here: your Claude app connects to XcreenShot, looks at your captures and renames them with its own account. Nothing is sent to the cloud by XcreenShot.
ai.mcp_copied: Copied. In Claude Desktop: Settings > Developer > Edit Config; paste it (inside mcpServers if the file already has servers) and restart Claude.
ai.mcp_copied_code: Copied. Paste it in a terminal.

library.empty_help: Every capture is saved here. Take one to get started.

library.no_results: Nothing matches the filters or the search.

tags.delete_body_one: {{tag}} is removed from {{count}} item. The item stays.
